newsitem.title: USA: Disney confirms plans to keep Fairchild.
newsitem.headline: Disney confirms plans to keep Fairchild.

text.p: Walt Disney Co Friday confirmed it plans to keep its Fairchild Publications group, publisher of fashion magazines such as "Women's Wear Daily" and "W".

A spokesman for the entertainment giant said Disney officials have decided to remove the Fairchild group from a list of former Capital Cities publishing assets currently under consideration for a possible sale.
Employees of Fairchild were informed of the decision on Thursday.

Last week Disney said it may sell all or part of the Capital Cities publishing operations, which include magazines and newspapers. A spokesman for Disney said the review process is continuing for the other assets.
The company said it will also put Los Angeles Magazine under Fairchild's control.
